conclusions.scope: The media half-scaled shifted loss addresses the demonstrated cancellation and representable-mean overflow. Gradient lines are untouched. No formal source or model-format changes.
conclusions.compatibility: Last-bit loss changes remain possible for other normal inputs. Original non-finite mean paths used to proceed to update; candidate returns error before StepFrom. Do not claim all error-path updates preserved.
conclusions.coverage_limits: Focused results are not full package or full framework acceptance. Controlled valid trainer setup is internal; no claim that default training naturally reaches the extreme state.
conclusions.test_gaps: Translated/overflow regressions do not compare complete updated snapshots. Separate parent normal training control compares12 full snapshots and StepResults within each build; that does not establish arbitrary extreme-state update equivalence.
conclusions.same_pattern: Agent identified textgen model.go same-pattern arithmetic. Root subsequently confirmed dynamic NLL/Step failures, wrote frozen red regression and a separate candidate; this textgen candidate was not part of the peer patch review.
conclusions.vocabulary: Subset mutation panic is observed; supported customization contract remains unknown. No API redesign adopted.
